episode_title: #398 – Cathie Wood om krypto, Tesla och Elon Musk

recommendations.speaker: Cathie Wood
recommendations.reasoning: ARK's largest holding. Robotaxi commercial service launching in Austin June 2025. FSD approaching human performance (700,000 miles between interventions expected fall 2025). Autonomous taxi platform represents 8-10 trillion dollar opportunity globally in 5-10 years, driven by convergence of robotics, energy storage, and AI. Price target $2,600. Elon committed to 5 more years.
recommendations.quote: Tesla is not only ARK's largest holding, but it's also the second most owned US stock among our customers. Elon is pulling back from the government, having put his people in place there to get the job done and is going to focus much more, he committed today actually, to five more years at least. He wants to be at the vanguard of humanoid robots and he thinks Tesla is going to be number one. Today, Elon reiterated that Tesla is launching its commercial robotaxi service in Austin in June. That's why I believe he has been willing to launch the commercial service in Austin just to get the ball rolling in June in Austin.

recommendations.speaker: Cathie Wood
recommendations.reasoning: Sold stock after Toyota pivoted from battery electric vehicles to hydrogen fuel cell vehicles at government request. Analysis showed hydrogen infrastructure buildout would be way more expensive than electric. Toyota may be rethinking the decision now.
recommendations.quote: When Toyota decided to pivot at the request of its government from battery electric vehicles to hydrogen fuel cell vehicles, we sold the stock because we had already done the analysis that the infrastructure build out would be way more expensive than electric. So now I think Toyota is even rethinking that.

recommendations.speaker: Cathie Wood
recommendations.reasoning: ARK is involved with Coinbase. Many clients play Bitcoin exposure through Coinbase instead of buying Bitcoin outright due to portfolio restrictions. Provides platform exposure to crypto trading and spot Bitcoin ETFs.
recommendations.quote: We're involved with Coinbase. That's great for exchanges. Many of our clients wouldn't let us put it in in the portfolios. So others are playing it through Coinbase.

recommendations.speaker: Cathie Wood
recommendations.reasoning: eToro recently went public and was added to ARK's portfolios. Platform has crypto strategy, providing exposure to digital assets through platform play.
recommendations.quote: eToro here in Europe has just went public and we added it to our portfolios. It has a crypto strategy. So many are forced to go in directly just because they're platforms.

recommendations.speaker: Cathie Wood
recommendations.reasoning: Price target 1.5 million USD. Becoming substitute for gold as store of value. Supply growth dropped below gold's 1% (now 0.9%). Institutional investment will drive demand with only 1 million Bitcoin remaining to be minted ($100 billion). Spot Bitcoin ETFs provide exposure. Personally owns Bitcoin outright.
recommendations.quote: Personally, I have bought Bitcoin outright. Institutions and asset allocators have a duty to assess whether it deserves a role in the portfolios. The $100 billion that I mentioned, institutions have to either take up those newly minted Bitcoin, and that's going to happen over years and years, or they'll have to pay up to get holders to sell it. So again, scarcity of value will drive or will increase because of the supply demand imbalance.

recommendations.speaker: Cathie Wood
recommendations.reasoning: Mentioned as Swedish tech company on right side of change. Will experience volatility but represents innovation. Not a specific recommendation, just acknowledgment.
recommendations.quote: It has been a beautiful thing to see Spotify and Klarna. And I realize every one of these companies is going to experience volatility, but they're on the right side of change.

recommendations.speaker: Cathie Wood
recommendations.reasoning: Mentioned as innovative Swedish company. Klarna pulled software-as-a-service services in-house, ahead of vibe coding trend. On right side of change but will experience volatility.
recommendations.quote: To see Klarna basically say, hey, we can pull these software as a service, services that we're taking and do it ourselves. Because guess what? They were ahead of the game on what we now know as vibe coding. We're all going to become coders. So Klarna, when they made that dramatic action, which I think was almost a year ago now, was on to this idea of vibe coding before most of the rest of the world. So congratulations, Sweden.

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Cathie Wood discusses Tesla as ARK's largest holding and explains why despite brand destruction concerns and negative sentiment, she remains highly bullish. She emphasizes Elon Musk's commitment to five more years, the imminent launch of commercial robotaxi service in Austin, and FSD approaching human-level performance. The valuation thesis is built on autonomous taxi platforms representing 8-10 trillion dollar opportunity from convergence of robotics, energy storage, and AI.

quotes.speaker: Cathie Wood
quotes.text: Tesla is not only ARK's largest holding, but it's also the second most owned US stock among our customers.

quotes.speaker: Cathie Wood
quotes.text: He committed today actually, to five more years at least. And I believe the reason he did that is because not only does he want to see the robo taxi proliferation throughout the United States and perhaps the rest of the world, but he also wants to be at the vanguard of humanoid robots. And he thinks Tesla is going to be number one.

quotes.speaker: Cathie Wood
quotes.text: When one of his companies starts missing those milestones, as the Model 3 production did in 2018 and 2019, so-called production hell, you will find him sleeping on the floor in the factory. He becomes maniacally focused on whatever the bottlenecks are, whatever the gating factors are.

quotes.speaker: Cathie Wood
quotes.text: Today, Elon reiterated that Tesla is launching its commercial robotaxi service in Austin in June. So that's good. We have seen the odds of failure go down with every update of FSD, full self-driving.

quotes.speaker: Cathie Wood
quotes.text: If you look at the miles between critical interventions, Tesla is moving toward that 700,000 miles that is characterized by human drivers, miles per intervention. Elon and team believe that FSD and therefore, RoboTaxi will surpass human performance this fall.

quotes.speaker: Cathie Wood
quotes.text: So you've got, well, there are three of them. They are robotics, energy storage, and AI. Three major innovation platforms. Each one has its own S-curve. And now they're intersecting. One is feeding the other in the form of autonomous taxi platforms. We think that's an 8 to 10 trillion dollar opportunity globally in the next 5 to 10 years.

bull_case: Commercial robotaxi service launching June 2025 in Austin
FSD approaching human performance (700,000 miles per intervention target fall 2025)
Elon Musk committed to 5 more years
Convergence of robotics, energy storage, and AI creating autonomous taxi platforms
8-10 trillion dollar global opportunity in autonomous taxis over 5-10 years
Tesla positioned as leader in humanoid robots

Regulatory hurdles for FSD outside US
catalysts: Commercial robotaxi service launch in Austin June 2025
Elon Musk focusing more on Tesla after government involvement
risks: Regulatory restrictions on autonomous driving in Europe and other regions

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Cathie Wood presents her bullish case for Bitcoin with 1.5 million USD price target. Key drivers include Bitcoin becoming a substitute for gold as store of value among younger generations, supply growth dropping below gold's rate (now 0.9%), and massive institutional investment potential. She emphasizes the scarcity value with only 1 million Bitcoin left to be minted and discusses volatility decreasing over time.

quotes.speaker: Host
quotes.text: Bitcoin reaching 1.5 million USD or Tesla reaching $2,600?

quotes.speaker: Cathie Wood
quotes.text: I have to say Tesla. Hesitantly though, only because the distance between here, say $330 and $2600 is less than the distance between a hundred and four thousand and 1.5 million. But our confidence in both is very high.

quotes.speaker: Cathie Wood
quotes.text: The key drivers, there are three. The first is, it is becoming a substitute for gold in terms of a store of value. Younger people prefer Bitcoin than gold. And I think they do believe that it is basically the same thing. Both of their prices are determined by scarcity value.

quotes.speaker: Cathie Wood
quotes.text: With the latest halving last year, the supply growth now is roughly 0.9%. And that will continue to go down with time, which is unlike gold. If the gold price keeps going up, that supply growth will pick up in its pace. That cannot happen with Bitcoin.

quotes.speaker: Cathie Wood
quotes.text: The $100 billion that I mentioned, institutions have to either take up those newly minted Bitcoin, and that's going to happen over years and years, or they'll have to pay up to get holders to sell it.

quotes.speaker: Cathie Wood
quotes.text: If you look at Bitcoin over time, the volatility was incredible in the early days, 200, 300 percent. It has been coming down consistently, 40, 50 percent now.

quotes.speaker: Cathie Wood
quotes.text: Personally, I have bought Bitcoin outright. Many of our clients wouldn't let us put it in in the portfolios.

bull_case: Bitcoin becoming substitute for gold as store of value
Younger generations prefer Bitcoin over gold
Supply growth below gold's rate (0.9% vs 1%)
Only 1 million Bitcoin left to mint ($100 billion)
Institutional adoption will drive massive demand

insights.quote: What you usually see towards the end of a correction or a bear market is our stocks tend to start outperforming before the broader market does. So, and that has happened this time, in this time as well. We went through tariff turmoil. We went down more than the market and now we're up more than the market.
insights.summary: Innovation stocks often lead market recoveries, outperforming before broader market after corrections
insights.speaker: Cathie Wood

insights.quote: The ironic thing is when consumers and businesses are afraid or concerned, worried about the future, they are more willing to change the way they're doing things. So better, cheaper, faster, more productive, more efficient, more creative products and services.
insights.summary: Crisis and fear drive innovation adoption as people seek better solutions
insights.speaker: Cathie Wood

insights.quote: If you look at the Mag 6 over the last five years, they're up fivefold while truly disruptive innovation is up only 30% if we look at that segment of the market. We think those places are going to switch going forward.
insights.summary: Market concentration can reverse - overperformers can underperform and vice versa in future
insights.speaker: Cathie Wood

insights.quote: Our own investment time horizon is five years. Our modeling often goes out beyond that, but we have to believe that a company, that the market is going to start discounting the opportunity within five years.
insights.summary: Five-year investment horizon appropriate for innovation stocks with market recognition timeline
insights.speaker: Cathie Wood

insights.quote: What we assume, given that our stocks typically sell at a premium, a significant premium to the market, on average, 90% premium since ARK was founded, we assume that that premium is going to compress or decay to a market multiple in the next five years. And we must assume that the combination of revenue growth and margin expansion, which of course turns into cash flow, is going to overwhelm that valuation compression
insights.summary: High valuation premiums must be overwhelmed by revenue growth and margin expansion to deliver returns
insights.speaker: Cathie Wood

insights.quote: The search for yield over the last, well, since interest rates went up so much has gone to an extreme, I think. And we've seen equity inflows into that part of the market. And it really just tells you that the bull market has not been that healthy. There's a lot of fear out there.
insights.summary: Yield-chasing signals unhealthy bull market with underlying fear
insights.speaker: Cathie Wood

insights.quote: He looks at a problem to be solved, whether it's in the government or in his various companies. And with his team, he figures out, using first principles, not relying on any past history, how quickly something should happen and sets milestones along the way.
insights.summary: First principles thinking and milestone setting key to solving complex problems
insights.speaker: Cathie Wood

insights.quote: We've seen the odds of failure go down with every update of FSD, full self-driving. Now, your listener base, unless they're in the United States, is probably not familiar with FSD because regulators are not allowing it here.
insights.summary: Regulatory barriers can prevent market familiarity with new technologies
insights.speaker: Cathie Wood

crypto_mentions.speaker: Cathie Wood
crypto_mentions.quote: If I had to, I'd prefer to lose the brokerage account. Given that I think crypto is going to stun the world, at least the way I've positioned in certainly Bitcoin, the biggest.

crypto_mentions.speaker: Cathie Wood
crypto_mentions.quote: Doge is all about making government more efficient, bringing down government spending. Government spending is taxation. So I actually think Doge is a good thing.
crypto_mentions.context: Referring to Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), not the cryptocurrency

summary: Cathie Wood expresses extreme bullishness on innovation stocks, citing three major headwinds turning into tailwinds: interest rate shocks ending, market concentration reversing, and valuation premiums normalizing. She remains highly convicted on Tesla with robotaxi launch imminent and FSD approaching human performance. Bitcoin thesis centers on substitution for gold with institutional adoption potential. ARK's strategy focuses on companies with visionary management, technology moats, and strong execution.
key_takeaways: ARK sees three major headwinds turning into tailwinds for innovation stocks
Tesla robotaxi commercial service launching June 2025 in Austin
FSD expected to surpass human performance fall 2025
Bitcoin price target 1.5 million USD driven by institutional adoption and scarcity
Autonomous taxi platform represents 8-10 trillion dollar opportunity over 5-10 years
Europe behind Asia in innovation due to regulation but showing hope with crypto legislation
Volatility in innovation stocks appropriate given long-duration nature of opportunities
